comment.body:
Thanks — this is already narrow enough to investigate the insertion path. To decide whether the fix belongs in Quick Accent itself or in an app/IME-specific workaround, please provide:

**Needed**
1. Please confirm the exact Windows keyboard layout / IME that is active when you choose `」` in WeChat Desktop.
2. Please try the same Quick Accent selection in a plain editor such as **Notepad** and say whether it still inserts `「`, or whether the problem happens only in WeChat.
3. Please upload a short screen recording of the selection and resulting character (with any sensitive chat content hidden).

This will distinguish a general Quick Accent insertion bug from WeChat-specific punctuation conversion.

proposed_fixes.title: Normalize IME state before Quick Accent commits punctuation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Quick Accent currently replaces the typed character with BACKSPACE and then injects raw Unicode code units. If WeChat still has an active IME composition for that punctuation slot, the app can reinterpret the insertion and emit the mirrored bracket instead of the requested one.
plan: Reproduce the issue with the reporter’s exact keyboard layout / IME and compare WeChat against a plain editor such as Notepad.

If the IME-composition branch is confirmed, commit or cancel the active composition before sending the replacement Unicode sequence, or add a focused fallback insertion path for punctuation-only inserts.
Add regression coverage around punctuation injection so the selected character is committed exactly as shown in the Quick Accent toolbar.
verification: Use Quick Accent to pick `」` in WeChat Desktop and verify the inserted character is `」`, not `「`.
Verify the change does not regress Quick Accent insertion in a plain editor such as Notepad.

confidence.rationale: The SendInput path is the strongest current match, but the missing IME/layout details still matter for choosing the exact fix.
